g.text: Source: independent_v1/main_* only; 90 held-out instances (45 small / 30 medium / 15 large). Seed means per instance, then all instances at each scale
equally weighted. ALNS limits: 1000 / 1000 / 800 iterations; stage worker counts: 8 / 8 / 12. Training excluded. Solver families use their registered
search budgets; curves are not matched-wall-clock comparisons.
